claims.claim: The post frames 'best gym shoes for beginners' against stated, reader-facing criteria rather than an asserted ranking: a stable heel base, grip on indoor gym flooring, a fit that locks the heel, and moderate (not plush) cushioning - then names which OFFLIMITS models meet those criteria for a first pair.
criteria: Stability under load (flat, wide heel base rather than a soft raised running heel)
Grip on indoor gym flooring (rubber/TPR-type outsole)
Fit that locks the heel with thumb-width toe room, within the size range actually stocked
Moderate cushioning suitable for mixed beginner sessions (memory foam insock, not a stacked running midsole)
Available in the brand's gym/training collections at entry price points
claims.note: No claim of superiority over any competitor or any other brand's shoe is made in the copy. 'Best for beginners' resolves strictly to fitness-for-purpose against the criteria above, evidenced by the brand's own product specs.

claims.claim: ROGER and HACHIKO use an EVA sole with a mesh/synthetic upper and a memory foam insock; IRONHIDE uses a Phylon/TPR sole with a mesh/TPU upper and memory foam insock; PALOMA FOR HER uses a Flyknit upper, Phylon midsole, TPR outsole and memory foam insock.

Men's gym/training models (ROGER, HACHIKO, IRONHIDE) are stocked in sizes 6-11; PALOMA FOR HER is stocked in sizes 3-7. Sizes 12, 13 and 14 are served by the separate Big & Tall collection, which stocks ROGER (BIG & TALL), SPARTA (BIG & TALL) and GLADIATOR (BIG & TALL).
claims.note: Discrepancy logged: the brand's own published post 'No More Squeezing In' states 'our gym and training shoes come in sizes 12, 13, 14, and beyond'. The rendered gym/training product pages show 6-11, and 12-14 sits in the Big & Tall collection. Copy therefore routes size 12-14 readers to Big & Tall by name rather than repeating the blanket claim. Raised in open_questions.

claims.claim: Memory Foam is a brand-sanctioned OFFLIMITS technology name and appears as the insock spec on every beginner model cited.
OFFLIMITS is an Indian D2C sports brand launched by Gurukirpa Lifestyle Company, positioned as international-standard performance at value-for-money prices, made in India.

detector_notes.note: ZeroGPT AI-text percentage. Weak editorial signal, not proof of authorship.

editorial_decisions: No rupee prices in the copy. Collection prices were captured at 70% off (promotional) and would date the post; relative range position ('entry of the range') is used instead. This is an evergreen-content decision, not an evidence gap - prices are logged in S3/S4.

No cloned men's/women's sections. The brief asks to route to gender-specific collections; routing happens inside one 'where to start' section, because parallel per-gender scaffolding is a P1 craft failure (editorial-craft.md) and the reviewer complaint on record was 'the men's and women's sections are identical'.

Wiktech, Athlite, Flexinit and Glovefit are real brand tech names but do NOT appear on the specs of the beginner models scraped, so they are not attributed to those models. Only Memory Foam, which is on every spec cited, is named.

sources.extracted_facts: brand_voice: motivational, gutsy, inclusive, value-conscious; 'OFF LIMITS Tribe'; 'push limits, not excuses'. Positioning: accessible high performance, made in India, designed for Indian conditions; positions against Nike/Adidas/Puma on price. Launched by Gurukirpa Lifestyle Company (~2M apparel, ~1M pairs/year). Real tech names: Advance Memory Foam, Athlite, Flexinit, Glovefit, Wiktech. Audience: value-seeking Indian fitness enthusiasts, students, recreational gym-goers, plus-size shoppers. Primary conversion: product purchase on Shopify.

Rules honored: Shopify + India (INR) scope; cite real tech names, avoid generic hype; pair performance with affordability and made-in-India; brand name inconsistent across site (OFF LIMITS / Offlimits / Off Limits) - open question, draft uses 'OFFLIMITS' per og:site_name; keyword volumes are estimated, never presented as measured; no GSC/GA4 connected, so no traffic, ranking or bestseller claims.
